svg.title: Proof of work — traffic, payments, search
svg.desc: Proof of work, part 1. 5,000+ — requests absorbed in one traffic spike. Bots + real users. Cloudflare CDN took the load before it reached the origin. 3 apps — Razorpay payments synced in real time. Webhook → Cloud Function → one Firestore write every app listens to. #1 — on Google for “DualMind Labs”. dualmindlab.tech.
